note: The klt build that GRADES this block's T1 state (klt signoff --manifest).
The pin below is the grader, and only the grader. klt-produced layout
evidence IS committed and cited as of 2026-11-14: the manifest cites the
five analog leaves' drc-report.json, lvs-report.json and
erc-supply-report.json under 2.analog / 3.analog / 4.analog / 11.analog.
Each of those was produced by a different klt build from this grader,
recorded per record as klt_version in
flow/analog-layout-<leaf>/records/<record>.md. (The physical-flow records
under flow/smoke-utmi_stub/ remain a toolchain smoke --
design.anchors_design_claim: false, flow/README.md -- and are still
deliberately NOT cited by the manifest.)
The convention to follow is gf180-temp-por's: pin the producer separately
from the grader, because the two move on different clocks.
Grader distribution discipline (load-bearing): the pin is the *PyPI
registry wheel*, never a same-version git snapshot or full-repo install.
Under the same version string, a git+... snapshot can grade differently
-- observed live for 0.5.0 (klayout-tools#2216) -- and the committed
signoff-report.json is only byte-reproducible when graded with the
distribution it was committed from. signoff/check.py asserts the full
build identity (git_tag v0.8.0, is_release true) before grading.
0.8.0 (issue #208) adds the item-6 `not_applicable` outcome for a digital
partition (klayout-tools#2865); 0.7.0 could not grade it. 0.7.0 bundled the 11-item checklist and grades item 11 and the
artifact-anchored generic envelopes for items 1, 2, 9 and 10
(klayout-tools#2718). The vendored checklist and the --tiers-doc flag that
worked around 0.5.0's 10-item bundle are retired (issue #165). `klt signoff
--attest` (klayout-tools#2844) is not in a released wheel, so the envelopes
under signoff/evidence/ for items 9 and 10 are hand-rolled over the
committed inventories in signoff/inventory/; a later re-pin can run
--attest over the same inventory files.
